svg.title: Five Lambdas, with separate execution paths.
svg.text: Five Lambdas, with separate execution paths.
Four jobs run the durable service. Shadow checks the feed policy in memory.
EventBridge schedules watcher, dispatcher, and reconciler
SQS mapping invokes the Slack worker
Recover overdue work; repair delivery state
Candidates and delivery records must be durable before a feed checkpoint advances.
Source: platform and processing specifications · ADR-026
